topic: Firmware update release notes and features
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on preparing a release note for an upcoming firmware update. Key features of the v53 (based on 00.01.14) update from Teltonika were reviewed, including:

*   Fixing a workaround for setting router time when NTP is unavailable.
*   Updating devmon to store additional fields for improved data quality.
*   Adding enhanced Wi-Fi channel scanning (disabled by default).
*   Implementing MQTT over SSL as a data transport protocol for consumption optimization.

It was decided that the 'trusted' feature would not be announced, and overall impact on services is not expected to change.
decisions: The release note must be prepared for the firmware update.
The 'trusted' feature will not be included in the announcement.
action_items: Send the release note to Gabrielle.
